title: Forbis's shader !
description: This is my own shader, i made just for fun. It add a vignette and fullbright
body:
# Simple Vignette & Fullbright

Welcome to my very first shaderpack! If you are looking for a lightweight, performance-friendly way to enhance your game's visuals without lagging your PC, this is exactly what you need.

I created this shader in just 30 minutes to fix a common issue: making the game look more vibrant and readable while keeping it completely vanilla-friendly.
 Key Features

     Cinematic Vignette: Adds a subtle, dark framing around the edges of your screen to increase immersion and focus.

     Built-in Fullbright: No more pitch-black caves or fumbling for torches! This shader ensures everything is perfectly visible, making mining and night exploration much easier.

     +30% Saturation Boost: Gives Minecraft's colors a beautiful, juicy pop without making them look deep-fried or unnatural.
